items.title: LinkedIn Job Application AutoFill
items.description:
# Job Application AutoFill

Auto-fill LinkedIn Easy Apply, Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever job applications. One profile setup, then it fills fields as you click through steps.

---

## 1. Download

[⬇️ Download Extension (.zip)](your-github-release-link)

Extract the `.zip` to a folder on your computer.

---

## 2. Build Your Profile

[📝 Open Profile Builder](/assets/config.html)

Fill the form → click **Generate** → **Copy** → paste into the `profile.json` file inside the downloaded folder → **Save**.

---

## 3. Install

Open Chrome → `chrome://extensions/` → turn on **Developer mode** → click **Load unpacked** → select the extension folder.

---

## How to Use

- Navigate to any job application. Fields fill automatically.
- 🟢 **Green** = from your profile | 🟠 **Orange** = review before submit
- If a field misses: click the puzzle piece icon → **Fill Current Page**

---

**Privacy:** 100% local. No accounts, no cloud, no data leaves your browser.
